goal: Define the smallest coherent ORODI vocabulary needed before Product Capability adoption, business-ontology admission, DomainSpec profile admission, and implementation binding.
goal_limits: ORODI product meaning and evidence boundaries
no ontology, profile, capability, implementation, runtime, publication, release, or deployment effect
original_intent: Make ORODI explicit as governed definitions so its Product Capabilities, business ontology, DomainSpec profile, system ontology, and implementation can depend on stable meanings instead of an informal glossary.

context.name: Craft ORODI operational resilience and delivery evidence
context.statement: The capability-local language used to evaluate operational and delivery claims without allowing evidence, observation, simulation, or validation to create effect authority.
context.provenance: User-directed definition work grounded in the existing ORODI Invoke Define sources and audited against the current ORODI ontology and immutable Product Capability candidate manifest.

consumer.intended_use: Candidate semantic predecessor for review before successor Product Capability, business-ontology, DomainSpec profile, compiled system-ontology, implementation-binding, and conformance artifacts are produced.

canonical_bindings.use: Bounds ORODI claims to exact supporting evidence.
Places admitted definitions before Product Capability, ontology, DomainSpec, system ontology, implementation, and conformance.
Keeps ORODI definitions separate from immutable Product Capability records.

handled_definitions.term: Operational Resilience, Observability, and Deployment Integration
handled_definitions.normative_voice: ORODI is the governed Craft capability family that makes bounded operational-resilience and delivery claims evaluable through exact evidence while keeping observation, evaluation, protected effects, and owner authority separate.
handled_definitions.formal_voice: ORODI = (R, O, D, B), where R is resilience outcome semantics, O is product observation and evidence, D is delivery-transition integration, and B is the non-collapse and non-actuation boundary set; no element may imply authority outside B.
handled_definitions.plain_language_voice: ORODI tells us whether a system stayed healthy, degraded safely, or recovered during change, without pretending that a dashboard or passing test gave permission to deploy.
handled_definitions.domain_context_voice: For Craft, ORODI connects offline evidence replay, denied runtime projection, canary evaluation, rollback verification, a run-ready local lab, and separately authorized commissioning.
handled_definitions.boundary: ORODI is not a monitoring tool, deployment platform, SRE process, ontology admission, implementation claim, production-readiness certificate, or effect authorization. ORRI and ORDI are not accepted aliases in this pack.
handled_definitions.challenge_or_refresh_route: Return semantic challenges through CA2-ROUTE-DEFINE; changed meaning requires a successor pack and new digest-bound review.

handled_definitions.normative_voice: Operational Resilience is the evidenced ability of a bounded system to preserve or restore declared critical outcomes under declared stressors, within declared degradation and recovery limits.
handled_definitions.formal_voice: Resilient(S,K,F,W,P,E) holds only when exact system S, critical outcomes K, stressors F, evaluation window W, policy P, and fresh evidence E are bound and E proves preserve(K) or recover(K) within P; missing(E) yields not_evaluable, never true.
handled_definitions.plain_language_voice: A system is resilient only when we can show what mattered kept working or was restored within the promised limits when something went wrong.
handled_definitions.domain_context_voice: ORODI evaluates resilience through finite evidence sets, canary observations, rollback restoration, and explicit degraded or terminal outcomes.
handled_definitions.boundary: Operational Resilience is not generic uptime, the absence of alerts, static configuration validity, an unbounded aspiration, or proof from one successful test.
handled_definitions.challenge_or_refresh_route: Challenge critical outcomes, stressors, or recovery bounds through the Craft ORODI Business Ontology owner, then refresh through CA2-ROUTE-DEFINE.

handled_definitions.normative_voice: Operational Evidence is an immutable, provenance-bound set of observations and evaluations about one exact operational subject, environment, time window, policy, and evidence state.
handled_definitions.formal_voice: OperationalEvidence = (subject, environment, observations, evaluator, policy, created_at, expiry, invalidation_keys, provenance, state, receipt_digest); authority_effect = none.
handled_definitions.plain_language_voice: It is the exact record of what we observed, how we judged it, when it was valid, and what would make it stale.
handled_definitions.domain_context_voice: ORODI uses operational evidence for replay, runtime projection, canary comparison, infrastructure-plan evaluation, deployment observation, and rollback verification.
handled_definitions.boundary: Operational Evidence is not authority, an effect, a live fact without source admission, or a guarantee beyond its bound subject, environment, time, and denominator.
handled_definitions.challenge_or_refresh_route: Challenge evidence meaning through the Craft ORODI Business Ontology owner and evidence authenticity through the applicable evidence owner.

handled_definitions.normative_voice: An Evaluation Binding is the immutable identity set that fixes every subject, environment, owner, artifact, configuration, topology, profile, tool, policy, threshold, fixture, observation, evaluator, receipt, freshness, invalidation, and supersession dependency used by one operational evaluation.
handled_definitions.formal_voice: EvaluationBinding = (subject_id, environment_id, owner_refs, artifact_digests, config_digest, topology_digest, profile_refs, tool_versions, policy_digests, thresholds, fixture_digest, observation_refs, evaluator_digest, receipt_schema_digest, created_at, expires_at, invalidation_keys, supersedes_ref); any required unresolved member => missing or invalid.
handled_definitions.plain_language_voice: Before trusting a result, freeze exactly what was tested, where, with which rules and tools, from which observations, and for how long the result stays valid.
handled_definitions.domain_context_voice: Every ORODI replay, projection, canary, plan, deployment, and rollback claim is evaluated only inside one exact binding.
handled_definitions.boundary: A complete Evaluation Binding proves identity completeness, not source authenticity, runtime truth, policy correctness, owner acceptance, or execution authority.
handled_definitions.challenge_or_refresh_route: Changed selected dependencies invalidate the binding and require a successor evaluation epoch.

handled_definitions.normative_voice: Evidence State is the disjoint typed condition of one evaluated obligation: passed, failed, missing, invalid, inconclusive, stale, or not-run.
handled_definitions.formal_voice: EvidenceState in {passed, failed, missing, invalid, inconclusive, stale, not-run}; pairwise_disjoint(EvidenceState); aggregate may return passed only when every required denominator member is present, valid, fresh, executed, and passed.
handled_definitions.plain_language_voice: No data, bad data, old data, unfinished data, a failed check, and a check we never ran are different facts and must stay different.
handled_definitions.domain_context_voice: ORODI preserves these states across child controls, aggregate claims, canary analysis, and rollback verification.
handled_definitions.boundary: Missing, invalid, inconclusive, stale, and not-run are never aliases for passed; absence of a failure is not evidence of success.
handled_definitions.challenge_or_refresh_route: Challenge state semantics through the Craft ORODI Business Ontology owner; evaluator mappings remain profile-owned.

handled_definitions.normative_voice: Failure Meaning Separation is the invariant that domain failure, integration outcome, and runtime exception mapping remain distinct owner-defined concepts throughout evaluation and recovery.
handled_definitions.formal_voice: DomainFailure != IntegrationOutcome != RuntimeException; map(RuntimeException, Profile) -> IntegrationOutcome and interpret(IntegrationOutcome, DomainPolicy) -> DomainFailure?; neither mapping may redefine its target vocabulary.
handled_definitions.plain_language_voice: A library error, a boundary timeout, and the business outcome that failed are related, but they are not the same thing.
handled_definitions.domain_context_voice: ORODI records tool and runtime failures through profiles while preserving DomainSpec-owned failure meaning and continuation ownership.
handled_definitions.boundary: A tool exception cannot create domain meaning, and a domain failure does not prescribe one runtime exception or retry mechanism.
handled_definitions.challenge_or_refresh_route: Route domain meaning to the domain owner, integration outcomes to the integration owner, and exception mapping to the profile owner.

handled_definitions.normative_voice: Product Observability is the bounded ability to derive evidence about a product subject from admitted traces, metrics, logs, exemplars, health facts, and their complete accounting, without granting the observer actuation authority.
handled_definitions.formal_voice: Observe(subject, environment, window) -> ObservationSet; observer_effects subset_of {append_evidence}; observer_effects intersection {deploy, shift_traffic, inject_fault, rollback, admit, promote, release} = empty.
handled_definitions.plain_language_voice: Observability lets us understand what the product did; it does not let the observer change what the product is doing.
handled_definitions.domain_context_voice: ORODI keeps product telemetry separate from Arcanum workflow telemetry and uses it only through bound evidence contracts.
handled_definitions.boundary: Workflow or agent telemetry is not product-runtime evidence, and the presence of a dashboard or signal does not prove coverage or correctness.
handled_definitions.challenge_or_refresh_route: Challenge product meaning through the Craft ORODI Business Ontology owner and signal admission through the applicable observability owner.

handled_definitions.normative_voice: Telemetry Conservation is the accounting invariant that every offered observation is queued or rejected, and every queued observation is exported, dropped, or pending, with partial success and loss explicit.
handled_definitions.formal_voice: offered = queued + rejected; queued = exported + dropped + pending; all quantities are nonnegative and scope-identical; closure false => evidence completeness is inconclusive or invalid.
handled_definitions.plain_language_voice: Every signal must have a known fate; if some disappeared and we cannot account for them, we cannot call the evidence complete.
handled_definitions.domain_context_voice: ORODI requires telemetry accounting before stable/candidate comparisons or operational claims can pass.
handled_definitions.boundary: Telemetry Conservation proves accounting closure, not semantic correctness, representativeness, privacy compliance, or that the observed system behaved well.
handled_definitions.challenge_or_refresh_route: Challenge accounting semantics through the Craft ORODI Business Ontology owner and counters through the telemetry profile owner.

handled_definitions.normative_voice: Deployment Integration is the governed linkage among exact stable and candidate identities, compatibility and infrastructure-plan evidence, bounded canary analysis, separately authorized transition effects, deployment observation, rollback policy, and terminal restoration evidence.
handled_definitions.formal_voice: DeploymentIntegration = (stable_digest, candidate_digest, compatibility_evidence, plan_evidence, canary_policy, transition_authorization_ref?, deployment_evidence?, rollback_policy, restoration_evidence?); analysis and observation fields never create transition_authorization_ref.
handled_definitions.plain_language_voice: It connects the evidence before, during, and after a change while keeping the decision to make the change with its protected owner.
handled_definitions.domain_context_voice: ORODI joins canary evaluation, deployment observation, rollback restoration, and commissioning without collapsing their owners or lifecycle states.
handled_definitions.boundary: Deployment Integration is not deployment, continuous-delivery tooling, traffic-shift authority, release approval, or evidence that an environment changed.
handled_definitions.challenge_or_refresh_route: Challenge meaning through the Craft ORODI Business Ontology owner; effect authorization stays with the protected environment owner.

handled_definitions.normative_voice: Operational Simulation is a no-effect evaluation of declared operational or delivery transition logic in a simulated namespace with deployment_effect fixed to false.
handled_definitions.formal_voice: Simulation(inputs, model) -> simulated_evidence where deployment_effect = false and runtime_effect = false; simulated_evidence cannot satisfy obligations requiring independently observed environment effects.
handled_definitions.plain_language_voice: A simulation can show that our logic behaves as designed, but it cannot show that anything was actually deployed, rolled back, or restored.
handled_definitions.domain_context_voice: ORODI uses replay, projection, and tabletop evidence to test contracts while denying runtime and deployment admission.
handled_definitions.boundary: Simulation is not deployment, runtime evidence, commissioning, live observation, restoration proof, or effect authority.
handled_definitions.challenge_or_refresh_route: Challenge simulation semantics through the Craft ORODI Business Ontology owner and model fidelity through the applicable evaluator owner.

handled_definitions.normative_voice: Canary Analysis is a non-actuating comparison of exact stable and candidate cohorts under one bound workload, fault, telemetry, threshold, and missing-data policy that returns passed, failed, or inconclusive.
handled_definitions.formal_voice: AnalyzeCanary(stable_digest, candidate_digest, observations, policy) -> {passed, failed, inconclusive}; incomplete_or_unconserved(observations) => inconclusive; result.authority_effect = none.
handled_definitions.plain_language_voice: It compares the old and new versions under the same declared test and says whether the evidence supports continuing, stopping, or deciding nothing yet.
handled_definitions.domain_context_voice: ORODI binds deterministic stable/candidate routing, candidate-only faults, telemetry accounting, workload, and thresholds to one canary decision receipt.
handled_definitions.boundary: A canary-analysis result is not traffic-shift authority, deployment authorization, production proof, or a substitute for missing observations.
handled_definitions.challenge_or_refresh_route: Challenge canary meaning through the Craft ORODI Business Ontology owner and exact policies through the canary-policy owner.

handled_definitions.normative_voice: Runtime Evidence is operational evidence produced by an admitted observer during an authorized execution in the exact bound environment and accepted only for its declared subject, window, denominator, freshness, and invalidation keys.
handled_definitions.formal_voice: RuntimeEvidence subset OperationalEvidence where execution_ref != null, execution_authorization_ref != null, observer_admitted = true, environment_observed = bound_environment, and simulated = false.
handled_definitions.plain_language_voice: Runtime evidence comes from watching the real authorized run in the exact place we claim, not from a schema, replay, plan, or simulation.
handled_definitions.domain_context_voice: ORODI requires runtime evidence for commissioning and environment-behavior claims while keeping offline and projected evidence explicitly denied.
handled_definitions.boundary: Static tests, decoded receipts, generated projections, configuration, simulation, plans, and not-run packages are not Runtime Evidence.
handled_definitions.challenge_or_refresh_route: Challenge semantic fitness through the Craft ORODI Business Ontology owner and observation validity through the applicable runtime-evidence owner.

handled_definitions.normative_voice: Deployment Evidence is independent Runtime Evidence that an explicitly authorized environment transition occurred and that binds the observed pre-state, requested transition, resulting state, time, actor or controller, and exact stable and candidate identities.
handled_definitions.formal_voice: DeploymentEvidence = RuntimeEvidence + (authorization_ref, pre_state, requested_transition, observed_post_state, actor_ref, stable_digest, candidate_digest); observed_effect = true; authority_effect = none.
handled_definitions.plain_language_voice: It proves that an authorized change really happened and records what state the environment reached; it does not grant permission for the change.
handled_definitions.domain_context_voice: ORODI keeps simulated deployment separate from independently observed environment effects and uses deployment evidence as input to rollback and terminal-state evaluation.
handled_definitions.boundary: A deployment plan, command invocation, simulation, canary verdict, static configuration, or controller acknowledgement alone is not Deployment Evidence.
handled_definitions.challenge_or_refresh_route: Challenge deployment meaning through the Craft ORODI Business Ontology owner and observed effect validity through the deployment-evidence owner.

handled_definitions.normative_voice: Rollback Restoration Evidence is independent Runtime Evidence that, before the bound deadline, every resource in the complete rollback inventory has zero candidate reference and the declared stable identity and required critical outcomes are restored.
handled_definitions.formal_voice: Restored(inventory, deadline) iff complete(inventory) and forall r in inventory: candidate_refs(r, observed_at<=deadline)=0 and stable_digest(r)=expected_stable_digest and critical_outcomes_restored; invocation(rollback) alone is insufficient.
handled_definitions.plain_language_voice: Rollback is complete only when an independent check shows the candidate is gone everywhere it should be and the stable system is actually back.
handled_definitions.domain_context_voice: ORODI uses a recovery ledger, ordered rollback, complete resource inventory, deadline, and independent observer to establish restoration.
handled_definitions.boundary: Calling a rollback function, stopping one component, receiving a controller acknowledgement, or passing a tabletop test is not Rollback Restoration Evidence.
handled_definitions.challenge_or_refresh_route: Challenge restoration semantics through the Craft ORODI Business Ontology owner and inventory completeness through the rollback owner.

handled_definitions.normative_voice: Infrastructure Plan Safety is the fail-closed classification of exact infrastructure-plan facts as clean, destructive, or unknown under one bound policy before any protected apply decision.
handled_definitions.formal_voice: EvaluatePlan(plan_digest, policy_digest) -> facts x {clean, destructive, unknown}; unknown or destructive cannot imply apply_authorized; verdict.authority_effect = none.
handled_definitions.plain_language_voice: We inspect the exact proposed infrastructure change and call out safe-looking, destructive, and unknown parts before anyone decides whether to apply it.
handled_definitions.domain_context_voice: ORODI uses plan safety to prepare a bounded local lab while keeping apply, Docker, network, and environment authority separate.
handled_definitions.boundary: A clean plan is not apply authority, runtime validity, image availability, successful startup, commissioning evidence, or production safety proof.
handled_definitions.challenge_or_refresh_route: Challenge safety semantics through the Craft ORODI Business Ontology owner and exact policy facts through the infrastructure-policy owner.

handled_definitions.normative_voice: A Run-Ready Local Lab is a pinned, bounded environment package whose topology, contracts, static configuration, no-effect tests, operating guidance, teardown specification, and commissioning handoff are complete and validated without executing the environment.
handled_definitions.formal_voice: RunReadyLab = (artifact_digests, topology_digest, static_validation, no_effect_tests, operating_guide, teardown_spec, commissioning_handoff) where all required fields pass and runtime_state = not-run and effect_authority = none.
handled_definitions.plain_language_voice: Everything needed for a controlled local exercise is prepared and checked on paper and in static tests, but nothing has been started yet.
handled_definitions.domain_context_voice: ORODI's run-ready lab targets pinned containers, one network, zero persistent volumes, complete no-effect validation, and an explicit commissioning boundary.
handled_definitions.boundary: Run-ready does not mean images exist, startup succeeds, infrastructure is valid at runtime, the lab is commissioned, or any deployment effect is authorized.
handled_definitions.challenge_or_refresh_route: Challenge package completeness through the local-lab construction owner and semantic fitness through the Craft ORODI Business Ontology owner.

handled_definitions.normative_voice: Local Commissioning is one separately authorized, bounded execution of a Run-Ready Local Lab that prepares exact images, starts the local environment, runs declared workload and fault exercises, observes canary and rollback outcomes, retains evidence, tears down, and verifies zero residual state.
handled_definitions.formal_voice: Commission(lab_digest, authorization_ref, window) -> (runtime_evidence, teardown_evidence, residual_state); eligible only if exact authorization covers all effects; complete only if teardown_observed and residual_state = zero.
handled_definitions.plain_language_voice: Commissioning is the protected step where we actually run the local lab, observe the exercise, clean it up, and prove nothing was left behind.
handled_definitions.domain_context_voice: ORODI commissioning is local and separately gated; it includes workload, fault, canary, rollback, restoration, evidence retention, and teardown within one exact authorization envelope.
handled_definitions.boundary: A definition, candidate capability, accepted plan, run-ready package, static validation, or generated configuration does not authorize Local Commissioning; commissioning is not production deployment, release, or publication.
handled_definitions.challenge_or_refresh_route: Challenge meaning through the Craft ORODI Business Ontology owner; effect scope and execution remain controlled by the separately authorized ORODI commissioning owner.

downstream_alignment.required_successor_action: After definition-owner review and canonical promotion, create new digest-bound Product Capability, business-ontology, and DomainSpec-profile candidate epochs; do not mutate or adopt the current immutable candidates in place.

open_questions.question: Which of these 17 candidate terms should become shared CyberAlchemy canonical definitions and which should remain capability-local specializations?
open_questions.affected_use: Canonical definition promotion and every downstream D65 successor claim.

residue: The earlier GLOSSARY.md remains informative source material; it is not a canonical definition registry.
No CAV2-D identifier is allocated by this candidate pack; CAV2-D70 through CAV2-D81 remain withdrawn/reserved and must not be reused.
The current immutable Product Capability manifest, business-ontology candidate, and DomainSpec-profile candidate predate this pack and therefore do not bind its digest.

Definition review and promotion do not themselves adopt Product Capabilities, admit ontology or profile artifacts, select implementation, prove conformance, authorize commissioning, or authorize deployment.
ORRI and ORDI are treated as prior shorthand or misspellings, not accepted aliases; ORODI is the only acronym proposed here.
allowed_uses: preparation of a successor D65 construction epoch after an owner decision
blocked_actions: canonical definition promotion without an exact owner decision
allocation of canonical CAV2-D identifiers by this pack
in-place mutation or adoption of the existing immutable Product Capability candidates
claim_ceiling: Validated local candidate Definition Pack only. It makes ORODI terminology reviewable and maps existing downstream candidates to proposed meanings, but it creates no canonical definition, adoption, admission, implementation, conformance, runtime, publication, release, deployment, or authority effect.
